title: Clinical utility of a rapid two-dimensional balanced steady-state free precession sequence with deep learning reconstruction
summary: Prospective clinical evaluation of accelerated cine MRI with deep learning reconstruction in 108 participants with reader ratings and volumetry agreement; the DL reconstruction is the enabling AI and the clinical utility evaluation is suited. The conclusion is limited to the reported study setting.
